text: 9月12日举行的2026浦江创新论坛成果发布会科产融合生态研讨专场期间，上海概念验证平台联盟正式成立。据上海市科委消息，联盟首批成员由33家概念验证平台与未来产业基金组成，覆盖脑机接口、硅光、细胞与基因治疗等未来产业领域，以及集成电路、智能制造、绿色技术等重点产业方向。联盟将推动平台从“各自为战”转向“握指成拳”，重点开展能力梳理、资源共享、标准制订、人才培育等工作，建立项目互荐与联合验证机制，平台矩阵加速扩容。（第一财经）
text_en: During the science-industry integration ecosystem seminar session of the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum achievements release conference held on September 12, the Shanghai Proof-of-Concept Platform Alliance was officially established. According to the Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission, the alliance's first batch of members consists of 33 proof-of-concept platforms and future industry funds, covering future industry fields such as brain-computer interfaces, silicon photonics, and cell and gene therapy, as well as key industry directions such as integrated circuits, intelligent manufacturing, and green technology. The alliance will push platforms to shift from "fighting separately" to "forming a united fist," focusing on work such as capability mapping, resource sharing, standard formulation, and talent cultivation, establishing project mutual recommendation and joint verification mechanisms, and accelerating the expansion of the platform matrix. (Yicai)
